dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds many non‑obvious AWS specifics (e.g., CAD Impact.TotalImpact vs total spend, Budgets action single‑threshold limitation, CUR partition‑repair steps, kill‑switch pattern, approval‑gate design, recent 2024‑2026 feature changes). A capable model could list commands, but the skill provides decision‑trees and nuanced thresholds that a senior CloudOps engineer would learn.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Procedures are largely AWS‑specific (EventBridge → Lambda, Step Functions approval gate, Parameter Store kill‑switch), but the description of implementing the kill‑switch is generic (“check Parameter Store”) without concrete steps (e.g., IAM policy to read the parameter, Lambda code snippet). This genericness costs 2 points.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Provides a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never use automatic EC2‑stop in Budgets, never grant *:* IAM, never hard‑code webhook URLs). Minor gap: does not explicitly warn against using CloudWatch billing alarms as a substitute for CAD in real‑time scenarios.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete front‑matter, clear description, when‑to‑use/when‑not‑to‑use, activation triggers, full JSON invocation schema, and a strict output contract that an agent can parse reliably.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level summary, quick‑navigation table, then deeper sections (mindset, decision tree, guardrails, NEVER, heuristics). Some sections are lengthy, causing slight cognitive overload, but critical rules are not buried.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are tightly constrained (approval gate, kill‑switch, dry‑run) while notification‑only paths remain flexible. No over‑constraining of creative tasks.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (mindset → decision tree → guardrails → output format → NEVER → heuristic → recent features). Structure is consistent and aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides actionable CLI snippets, decision tree, example output blocks, and remediation steps that an agent can execute. Slight deduction for missing guidance on multi‑account scaling of monitors and for not covering every edge case (e.g., handling deleted resources in tag‑step).
